premises.text: Many people in recovery relapse within the first year
premises.evidence_span: 60% of people with drug and alcohol addiction relapse within the first year

premises.text: Relapse is caused by lack of communication and lack of accountability
premises.evidence_span: the two key things that cause relapse. One, lack of communication, and two, lack of accountability

premises.text: App plus wearables verifies attendance and engagement at recovery activities via geo and motion
premises.evidence_span: we're even able to tell if you showed up to your 12-step meeting just for the last five minutes or if you've been there and engaged the entire time

premises.text: Support network sees progress, gets alerts, and can be summoned with one SOS button when someone isolates
premises.evidence_span: We also provide alerts when someone is not doing their recovery program

premises.text: Points redeem for recovery-friendly rewards that deepen engagement
premises.evidence_span: really get the person engaged further into recovery

premises.text: Sell via inpatient centers first, then expand using center data into healthcare, insurance, and EAPs
premises.evidence_span: we're going to go next into health care providers, insurance companies, and employee assistance programs

value.text: Daily engaged recovery that reduces relapse risk
value.evidence_span: You have to be engaged into your recovery every single day

secondary_value.text: Saving lives of people affected by addiction

causal_links.evidence_span: first sales channel, which is inpatient treatment centers

notes: Treatment-center data usefulness folded into channel expansion premise. Market-size one-in-three/one-in-six framing not coded as premises.
